queries.label: sampleQueries[0]
queries.query:
UbiquitiAuditEvent
 | summarize count() by SrcIpAddr
 | top 10 by count_

queries.label: dataTypes[0].lastDataReceivedQuery
queries.query:
UbiquitiAuditEvent
            | summarize Time = max(TimeGenerated)
            | where isnotempty(Time)

queries.label: connectivityCriterias[0].value[0]
queries.query:
UbiquitiAuditEvent
            | summarize LastLogReceived = max(TimeGenerated)
            | project IsConnected = LastLogReceived > ago(30d)
